title: Federal learning method and device based on calculation network
assignee: China Mobile Communications Group Co Ltd

pse.problem: Low model recognition accuracy in security systems due to special scenarios and difficulty in timely upgrades.
pse.solution_function: Federated learning method facilitates continuous improvement of neural network models by collecting second model parameters from various security nodes, determining third model parameters based on parameter distances between groups, and updating participating nodes with the latest parameters.
pse.solution_structure: Computing power network consisting of security nodes (with hardware components such as logical computing chips, parallel computing chips, and neural network chips) that run a common neural network model and communicate to exchange parameters.
pse.solution_implementation: Security nodes send parameter requests for first model parameters, receive the neural network model and first parameters, perform local training to generate second model parameters, compare connection request data (computing power value and data information quantified value) with existing values to establish connections, and exchange second model parameters. Central entity aggregates second model parameters, compares distances between groups, determines third model parameters if distance is less than set value.
pse.effect: Improved recognition accuracy of neural network models in security systems by continuous learning from multiple nodes without requiring on-site updates.
